title: The Curse of Jurek
summary: Control the harsh winds thrown off by Ju`Rek as the fight progresses.
overview: Control the harsh winds thrown off by Ju`Rek as the fight progresses.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Have add control ready before every health threshold.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: At 95%, 80%, 60%, 40% and 20% health, Ju`Rek summons three harsh winds at his position.
The winds remain until defeated or the encounter resets.
Two minutes out of combat restores Ju`Rek and clears the wind adds.

notes: Approval E358. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
